node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path"),c=require("crypto");const data=Buffer.from(process.argv[1],"base64");const roots=[process.cwd(),p.join(process.cwd(),"ai-agent")];const root=roots.find(r=>fs.existsSync(p.join(r,"bridge/shell/dropbox_token.js")));if(!root)throw Error("AI_AGENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND "+process.cwd());const target=p.join(root,"bridge/shell/multi-task/shell_command.js");fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(target),{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync(target)){const existing=fs.readFileSync(target);if(existing.equals(data)){console.log("ALREADY_PRESENT "+target);process.exit(0)}throw Error("TARGET_EXISTS_DIFFERENT "+target)}fs.writeFileSync(target,data,{flag:"wx"});console.log("CREATED "+target+" SHA256 "+c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(target)).digest("hex"));' ''
